protocol_amendment.reason: Independent V4 red-team review found four bounded exact-type envelopes that raised instead of returning invalid receipts, plus a shared legacy fallback that could crash, accept an empty V3 document, and advertise checks that did not execute. The same review required a semantically independent frozen-B4 oracle and hand-derived family-gate boundaries.
changes: Accept only the V5 document schema and reject every V1-V4 schema without row verification.
Report route-specific check lists so unsupported legacy receipts never claim V5 mathematical reconstruction.
Bound input files, JSON nodes, nesting depth, strings and keys, factor-base sizes, optimizer node caps, and verifier primary-proof budgets.

Validate cap lengths, schedules, associations and positivity; selected-maximum degree, range, order, uniqueness and eligibility; optimizer index order and range; canonical hexadecimal masks; and node ceilings before replay or indexed access.
Wrap row, document-value, and file verifier entrypoints so every bounded malformed input returns a deterministic invalid receipt.

Add regressions for truncated caps, out-of-range and duplicate selected formals, negative caps, V5-body schema downgrades, malformed JSON, duplicate keys, nonobject roots, malformed schemas, and invalid verifier budgets.

Add a standalone frozen-B4 oracle that independently implements EC addition, factor-base selection, representative compilation, ideals, conflicts, retained-model costs, final support, and exhaustive five-field cap winners without producer or verifier semantic helpers.
Add hand-derived exact gate fixtures for duplicate-null median ties, 17 versus 18 positives, two versus three passing strata, fixed-cap anti-splicing, all-fail, and COLLAPSE.
Emit the preregistered complete-matrix negative classification as NOT_APPLICABLE, WEAKEN_OR_REJECT, or COLLAPSE.
Keep every development family-row and canonical run budget at zero.
unchanged_mathematical_boundary: The curve grid, predicates, nulls, representative compiler, ordering digest, graph object, cap schedule, five-field objective, matched-null thresholds, and positive gate remain unchanged.
Exactness remains finite and MODEL-BOUND to the fixed compiler and order-ideal construction.
No relation generation, rank, target descent, preprocessing crossover, rho comparison, exponent, deployment, or ECDLP result is in scope.
protocol_amendment.required_next_review: Fresh independent theory, accounting, and red-team review of one exact committed V5 snapshot. Three scoped GO decisions could authorize only a separate hash-complete launch-plan design, not execution.
